cards.quote: But it speaks to a very real problem we all have when it comes to reckoning with whatever the heck happened in the 2010s. It was the decade where the internet finally overtook television as the way culture was curated.

cards.quote: 2012-2015: This was the rise of both professional studios for YouTube and the viral Vine star. Solid color backdrops, shitty Jimmy Fallon-esque interview prompts, and a whole bunch of people eating snacks. This era peaked, and came crashing down, after Facebook tried to pay everyone to livestream.
